en.title: Disney Drops Holiday Short 'The Invisible Horse' From Paddington Director
en.summary: Get ready for some festive cheer! Disney Plus is releasing a heartwarming new holiday short film, 'The Invisible Horse,' just in time for the season. Directed by the acclaimed Dougal Wilson, this charming tale promises to capture the magic of Christmas.
en.body:
The holiday season is about to get a whole lot more magical, thanks to Disney Plus and the creative vision of **Dougal Wilson**. The director, who charmed audiences worldwide with **Paddington in Peru**, is set to release his latest project, a festive short film titled **‘The Invisible Horse’**. This heartwarming tale, designed to evoke the spirit of Christmas, will be available to stream starting November 9.

**‘The Invisible Horse’** follows a young boy who discovers the wonder of an invisible companion, a creature that serves as a potent reminder of the magic inherent in the holiday season. While the full plot details remain under wraps, early glimpses suggest a narrative rich in imagination and emotional depth. The film is part of Disney's broader initiative to infuse the holidays with a special kind of enchantment, building on a tradition of seasonal shorts that have become a beloved part of many families' festive routines. This year's offering follows in the footsteps of previous charming shorts, aiming to capture the hearts of viewers of all ages.

## A Magical Discovery

Disney has shared a brief trailer that opens with a serene farmhouse scene, blanketed in snow. The quiet is broken by the appearance of horse tracks in the fresh snow, leading towards a young boy standing on the porch. His hands reach out to something unseen, hinting at the gentle introduction of his invisible friend. This visual storytelling, even in its brief form, suggests a focus on wonder and the quiet moments that define childhood magic. The film aims to remind audiences, both young and old, of the simple yet profound joys that the holiday season can bring, emphasizing connection and imagination.

## What Fans Are Anticipating

The announcement has already sparked excitement among fans, particularly those who appreciate **Dougal Wilson**'s distinctive directorial style. His ability to blend whimsy with genuine emotion in **Paddington in Peru** has set high expectations for **‘The Invisible Horse’**. The inclusion of potential cameos, as hinted by early teasers mentioning characters like **Woody from 'Toy Story'** and **Elsa from 'Frozen'**, has also fueled speculation and delight within the Disney fan community. This short isn't just another holiday special; it's a chance to experience a director's unique take on holiday magic, delivered through the beloved lens of Disney storytelling. The anticipation is palpable as fans eagerly await a chance to dive into this new festive narrative.

## What's Next

**‘The Invisible Horse’** officially premieres on Disney Plus and the official Disney YouTube channel on November 9, offering a perfect pre-holiday treat.
